fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 2: how milestone 2 lives in the model, and the queue

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 2: how milestone 2 lives in the model, and the queue

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 2: how milestone 2 lives in the model, and the queue
fields.statement: depends-on means only "can't start before". The chain links between the twelve areas are retired, the areas become a backlog, and the milestone-2 group comes first in the roadmap; order inside a group follows real depends-on links, ties by ID.

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 2: how milestone 2 lives in the model, and the queue
fields.statement: Milestone work is carved out of the area bundles: each piece is its own change set with leaves, serving the milestone and relates-to its area; the bundle is revised to drop it and withdrawn when empty.

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 3: change sets that build on each other
fields.statement: A write in a change set sees as-is, plus every change set it transitively depends on that isn't rejected, withdrawn or superseded (drafts and proposals included), plus itself; the same for what-if and slice.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 3: change sets that build on each other
fields.statement: A change set lands only when everything it depends on has landed; otherwise land exits 3 with next naming the dependency in the way.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 3: change sets that build on each other
fields.statement: When a dependency is withdrawn or rejected, the operations that rest on it are reported by check and given by ready as the reason, never silently broken.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 3: change sets that build on each other
fields.statement: depends-on between change sets is acyclic: link refuses a link that would close a loop, and check reports any in the log.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 3: change sets that build on each other
fields.statement: A dependency revised under a change set shows up as a conflict through the base versions its operations carry; automatic rebase stays in the change-sets backlog, and the conflict fails loudly with next.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner
